name: Julius AI
tagline: Julius AI is a conversational data analysis tool that connects to spreadsheets, databases, and CSV files and lets you ask questions in plain English — producing charts, statistical summaries, and Python-generated insights without writing code. It can run regression analyses, detect trends, and generate publication-ready visualisations from natural-language instructions. Analysts, marketers, and researchers who work with data but aren't fluent in Python or SQL use Julius to move from raw data to insight in minutes.
